name: Céline Imart - Article 1, § 3, alinéa 2 - Am 43
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on providing macro-financial assistance to the Arab Republic of Egypt
part_text: The Commission shall regularly inform the European Parliament and the Council of developments regarding the Union's macro-financial assistance, including disbursements thereof, as well as on the progress made relating to economic and democratic reforms in Egypt and shall provide those institutions with the relevant documents, including third-party independent assessments, in due time.
